crossRefs.note: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.
I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.
“You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them…
Yahweh, you have persuaded me, and I was persuaded. You are stronger than I, and have prevailed. I have become a…
If I say, I will not make mention of him, or speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning…
The lion has roared. Who will not fear? The Lord Yahweh has spoken. Who can but prophesy?
and Yahweh took me from following the flock, and Yahweh said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to my people Israel.’
for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”
But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”
But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and…
But arise, and stand on your feet, for I have appeared to you for this purpose: to appoint you a servant and a witness…
I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.
Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell among a people of unclean…
But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”
Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”

translations.web: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about; for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t preach the Good News.
translations.bsb: Yet when I preach the gospel, I have no reason to boast, because I am obligated to preach. Woe to me if I do not preach the gospel!
translations.kjv: For though I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of: for necessity is laid upon me; yea, woe is unto me, if ➔ I preach ➔ not the gospel!
translations.asv: For if I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of; for necessity is laid upon me; for woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel.
